name: hcportal_getCityTimezones
description: Returns the relevant timezone(s) for a zone, identified either by @cityId (HC.City.TimezoneId) or — for free-text 'Other' locations — by a directly chosen @timezoneId (Event.TimezoneId); @cityId takes precedence. Derives the Standard and Daylight (DST) offsets via AT TIME ZONE, returning one row for zones without DST and two rows for zones that observe it. Used for the read-only timezone display in the run editor. Auth: HC6.ValidatePortalAuth (device-bound token, NULL callerParamString); no kennel permission gate. Offsets are probed at 1 Jan and 1 Jul of the current UTC year.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Auth: device ID used to look up the authenticated user and device secret. Validated via HC6.ValidatePortalAuth.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Auth: short-lived cryptographic token validated via HC6.ValidatePortalAuth.

parameters.name: cityId
parameters.description: The city whose timezone(s) to return. Takes precedence over @timezoneId.

parameters.name: timezoneId
parameters.description: Direct DomainValues.Timezone.id to resolve when there is no structured city (the manual 'Other' case). Ignored if @cityId resolves.

rowsets.name: ErrorEnvelope
rowsets.description: Returned instead of the result on auth failure or a runtime error from the CATCH block (e.g. an unknown Windows zone name in AT TIME ZONE).

rowsets.name: CityTimezonesResult
rowsets.description: 1 row (no DST) or 2 rows (Standard + Daylight), Standard first. Empty rowset with the same columns (SELECT TOP 0) when neither @cityId nor @timezoneId resolves to a DomainValues.Timezone row — including a city whose TimezoneId is NULL with no @timezoneId fallback.

columns.name: utcOffset
columns.description: Formatted offset 'UTC±HH:MM', e.g. 'UTC+00:00', 'UTC-05:00' (built from VARCHAR pieces; the empty TOP 0 branch declares NVARCHAR(20))

columns.name: ianaTimeZone
columns.description: IANA zone name from DomainValues.Timezone (e.g. 'Europe/London'); may be null

columns.name: windowsTimeZone
columns.description: Windows time zone id from DomainValues.Timezone (e.g. 'GMT Standard Time')

columns.name: observesDst
columns.description: 1 if the zone observes daylight saving (two rows), 0 if not (single row)

codeSmells.issue: CATCH does not log to HC.ErrorLog
codeSmells.detail: The CATCH block (line 112) returns the Success=0 envelope with ERROR_MESSAGE() but writes no HC.ErrorLog row, so a runtime failure is invisible server-side. CLAUDE.md: every CATCH must log to HC.ErrorLog.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
